title: Learned patch mask during training (LeNS-JEPA)
updated: 2026-11-16 (v02: no checkpoint marks, no pause, poster rule)

mask.definition: patch scorer (LayerNorm(384) -> Linear(384,64) -> GELU -> Linear(64,1)) on frozen DINOv2-S/14 final patch tokens; hard mask = logit > 0
mask.use: masked patches are hidden from the predictive encoder during training only; inference uses all patches
mask.overlay: masked patches tinted #F2B134 at alpha 0.5 on the clean frame, with a darker edge

frame_rule: first three frames (cohort indices 0, 1, 2) of the fixed 512-frame clean validation cohort used in the mask analyses: official-window validation windows in split order, excluding episodes of the test split, first observation of each window; rule fixed before rendering, no frame selection by mask appearance
poster_rule: per-task clip: the video frame showing the scorer snapshot with the largest mean hard-mask fraction over the 3 shown frames (earliest snapshot on ties); combined clip: the video frame with the largest mean hard-mask fraction over all 9 shown frames (3 frames x 3 tasks; earliest frame on ties)

curve.quantity: fraction of input patches hidden by the hard mask in training batches (train.mask_hard), logged every 50 updates
curve.drawn: light line = every 50 updates; dark line #6E5BA6 = centred rolling median over 11 log points (550 updates); revealed up to the cursor
curve.note: the curve is measured on training batches, the overlays on the three fixed validation frames; levels can differ at a single snapshot

timeline.snapshot_rule: shown snapshot = latest scorer snapshot at or before the current epoch (first snapshot before it exists), updated at 15 Hz; cursor and "epoch x.x" label give that snapshot's epoch (update / updates per epoch)

encoding.codec: H.264 High, yuv420p, bt709 tv range

combined.layout: TwoRoom, PushT, Reacher stacked; synchronised by epoch

scorer_snapshots.interval: every 500 updates plus each epoch end
every 500 updates plus each epoch end
